messages.subject: Carpentries RNA-seq lesson hackathon
messages.body_plain:
Hello everyone,

As discussed at the Bioconductor Teaching meeting today, we're going to have 2 x 1hr hackathon sessions this week to work on the RNA-seq lesson, and to improve it for Smorgasbord May 22-26 <https://gallantries.github.io/video-library/modules/bioconductor>. If you're interested in contributing to the lesson you are very welcome to join one or both sessions
Wednesday May 10th 3-4pm CEST
Friday May 12th 3-4pm CEST
Meeting Link:
https://meet.jit.si/BioconductorTeaching

Lesson:
https://carpentries-incubator.github.io/bioc-rnaseq/

Notes:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1YDKTeDX3z9W6eGbWaTQAUb_hs0iUC9saGvkO_Po5tfA/edit?usp=sharing

Hope to see you there!

Maria
